purpose: Fresh-seed validation of the complete owalnuts::sampler defaults after WP33 made ChainRescueConfig::restart_from_best() the default on identity and diagonal metrics. The posteriordb_bench_v5 protocol, model set, gates, estimators, chains, iterations, competitor versions and settings are repeated against CmdStan and nutpie. The oWALNUTS harness records every ChainRescueUpdate. This study validates and characterises an already-made default change; it does not decide the change.

predecessor.headline: 42/51 oWALNUTS cells passed against CmdStan 36 and nutpie 28; 0.822x CmdStan minimum bulk ESS per gradient over the fixed 16-model non-arma11 set; 0.801x wall per gradient; funnel |z| <= 1.02.
predecessor.change_since_predecessor: WP33 only: sampler::DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = ChainRescueConfig::restart_from_best() is now applied by Adaptation::DualAveraging and Adaptation::Paper on identity and diagonal metrics with at least two chains. The retained kernel, Tuning defaults, metric regularisation, warmup exhaustion rule and all competitor settings are unchanged.
predecessor.decision_study: STUDIES/chain_rescue_v1 (WP33, seeds 88101-88103): restart passed its preregistered rule, 25/27 cells against 21/27 for the plain driver, no new |z| > 3.5, and funnel tail mass remained within |z| <= 2.

kernel_under_test.api: owalnuts::sampler::Sampler with Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default(), Init::uniform() and Limits::admit_worst_case(); nothing overridden

sampler_defaults_under_test.chain_rescue: sampler::DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE = ChainRescueConfig::restart_from_best(); enabled because this is a four-chain adapted diagonal run
sampler_defaults_under_test.unchanged: h0 0.5, depth 10, min_micro_steps 1, eight refinement levels, delta 1, divergence threshold 1000, retained exhaustion rule Stop, dual averaging target 0.8, adapted diagonal metric from identity, cached initial evaluation

owalnuts-da.target: owalnuts-bridgestan ReplicatedStanTarget, four replicas; BridgeStan 2.9.0 / Stan 2.39.0 built without STAN_THREADS
owalnuts-da.settings: Sampler defaults exactly, four threads; the default restart-from-best chain rescue is active and every ChainRescueUpdate is recorded

cmdstan.settings: defaults: adapt_delta 0.8, max_treedepth 10, diag_e, uniform(-2,2) initialisation, four chains and four parallel chains

nutpie.settings: defaults: target_accept 0.8, maxdepth 10, four chains, default initialisation

seeds_verified_unused: Exact whole-number search for 90101, 90102 and 90103 over wiki/, non-artifact STUDIES files, src/, tests/ and examples/ before freezing found no use as a seed. Numeric substrings inside recorded floating-point artifacts were excluded.
run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, cmdstan, nutpie; seeds ascending; strictly sequential; then the funnel row
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; oWALNUTS draws constrained through BridgeStan with transformed parameters included
estimators: ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS at probabilities 0.05 and 0.95, and mean MCSE

metrics.gradients_total: oWALNUTS target calls including start search, warmup and sampling; CmdStan sum n_leapfrog__; nutpie sum n_steps
metrics.wall: seconds around one sampler call, warmup included and compilation excluded; oWALNUTS start search excluded
metrics.ess_per_gradient: minimum over reference parameters of bulk or tail ESS divided by gradients_total
metrics.ess_per_second: minimum over reference parameters of bulk or tail ESS divided by wall
metrics.agreement: z = (mean - mean_ref) / sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2); maximum absolute z over reference parameters; flag above 4
metrics.chain_rescue: all ChainRescueUpdate records by chain, window, transition, criterion, source and before/after score; aggregate rescue counts by criterion, model, seed and pass/fail outcome

funnel.tuning: Sampler defaults including restart-from-best chain rescue
funnel.statistic: per-seed MCSE z for P(omega < -5), plus omega bulk ESS and rank R-hat; every rescue event recorded

predictions.P1: owalnuts-da passes all gates on at least 42 of 51 cells, the v5 count before chain rescue became the default
predictions.P2: no passing owalnuts-da cell has max |z| > 4 against the posteriordb reference draws
predictions.P3: over the fixed 16-model non-arma11 set, owalnuts-da geometric-mean minimum bulk ESS per gradient versus CmdStan is at least 0.75 (v5: 0.822)
predictions.P4: over the fixed 16-model non-arma11 set, owalnuts-da geometric-mean wall per gradient is at most 1.0x CmdStan (v5 all-model figure: 0.801)
predictions.P5: owalnuts-da geometric-mean minimum bulk ESS per second versus nutpie is at least 1.5 over models complete on both sides (v5: 3.085)
predictions.P6: funnel tail mass has |z| <= 2 on every seed; omega ESS and R-hat are reported but not gated because WP33 showed an unbiased seed with R-hat 1.012
predictions.P7: restart-from-best improves or preserves the one-bad-chain failure class in aggregate: no frozen owalnuts chain, and rescue telemetry explains every cell whose gate result differs materially from v5; this is descriptive because seeds differ

release_rule: The run may replace the v5 breadth headline for the current 0.2.0 defaults if all 153 posteriordb cells are present, P1-P4 and P6 hold, and every passing owalnuts cell satisfies P2. P5 and P7 are reported. Failure does not automatically reverse the WP33 default; it is recorded next to the release numbers and triggers a separately preregistered decision study.
rules: Report all cells; no result-driven reruns; failures are results; no tuning after seeing results. A process crash may be relaunched and only an interrupted cell without a completed artifact may be rerun from scratch, with the deviation recorded. Walls are measured on a shared machine and are not used to alter sampler defaults.
